target_customer: Developers and companies that build MCP servers and apps for Claude, ChatGPT and other agent clients
problem: Teams shipping MCP servers need hosting, deployment, analytics, evals and marketplace submission tooling to get production-ready across clients.
business_model: Open-source SDK (mcp-use) with a paid cloud platform for MCP deployment, analytics and evals; pricing not captured
product_category: MCP cloud platform and developer infrastructure

founders.name: Pietro Zullo
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as founder/CEO of Manufact (formerly mcp-use) with no background given.

founders.name: Luigi Pederzani
prior_employers: Morgen (founding engineer, ETH spin-off AI startup)
education: POLIMI, MSc Computer Science and Engineering
founders.background_notes: YC page: former YouTube creator with 150k subscribers and over 15M views.

competitors.name: Smithery
competitors.what: registry and hosting platform for MCP servers
competitors.traction_then: thousands of listed servers per a vendor comparison

competitors.name: Composio
competitors.what: managed MCP platform with hundreds of vetted servers

technical_complexity.rationale: An SDK and managed hosting for a new protocol is standard infrastructure engineering, with hard parts in auth, sandboxing and cross-client compatibility.

defensibility.rationale: The open-source SDK built developer mindshare, but hosting is easy to copy and Cloudflare and others offered remote MCP hosting.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent acquisition found; platforms competed on hosting and the protocol owner kept expanding native support.

market_need_then: MCP adoption by Claude and ChatGPT in 2025 created demand for deployable servers and marketplace-ready plugins; the SDK passed millions of downloads by early 2026.

branding.domain_note: Now uses manufact.com; previous identity was mcp-use with mcp-use docs domain; purchase history not found.

identity.logo: logo asset published on the developer page (not viewed)
identity.visual_style: short headings and feature lists per site fetch

branding.brand_signature: mcp-use open-source SDK with 10k GitHub stars as the origin story

rebrands.why: Third-party coverage says the rename moved from a descriptive open-source name to a brand for the commercial platform; the SDK keeps the mcp-use name.

branding.community_and_virality: Open-source SDK with about 9,000 to 10,000 GitHub stars and 5M+ downloads per press

brand_strength.rationale: The SDK brand had real developer traction, but the new name is unrelated to MCP and only recently introduced.

outcome_analysis: Manufact grew out of the open-source mcp-use SDK, which gave it developer distribution before the YC Summer 2025 batch. It rode the 2025 MCP adoption wave and raised a $6.3M seed led by Peak XV in February 2026 on the strength of SDK downloads and early customers such as AgentMail. The risk is that hosting is commoditized by larger platforms, but no negative outcome has been reported.
notes: The YC page cites VentureBeat dated 2026-03-11 while other sources date the announcement to February 2026; February recorded. Competitor sources are vendor comparisons from 2025 and 2026 with imprecise dates. Rebrand date from mcp-use to Manufact not found. Reports of a later CTO, Enrico Toniato, come from aggregators and are not listed as a founder.
